weather_report:
Subiaco dozes under a patchwork sky, the small hours cool and still, streetlight halos softened by broken cloud. It isn’t a night for stars so much as a quiet ceiling of moving gray, with the promise of a gentle, filtered dawn. UV is of no concern now, and the air feels clean, the world pared back to footsteps, distant tires, and breath.

Toward morning, expect the clouds to linger in tatters, letting through intervals of mellow sunshine rather than a hard, blue blaze. The day looks easy on the eyes—bright at times, but with softened edges—so UV will start low and build modestly by late morning despite the cloud breaks; a hat, sunglasses, and a touch of sunscreen will serve you well if you linger outdoors. Dress in light layers: a soft top with a breathable jacket for the early cool, easy to shed when the sun finds you. It’s a day for ordinary pleasures—an unhurried walk to pick up bread, a potter in the garden before the light strengthens, a short ride to run an errand, or reading by a window when the sky brightens and dims in slow rhythm. Pleasant, unhurried weather, asking only that you keep an eye on the changing light.
